data.one_liner: A native Dart implementation of portals for Linux desktop applications.
data.what_it_does: Allows Dart applications to use desktop portals available on Linux. It supports various portals such as notifications, file chooser, location, network monitor, background, camera, and settings.
use_when: You are building a Dart or Flutter application targeting the Linux desktop.
Your Linux application needs to interact with system services using xdg-desktop-portal.
avoid_when: You are developing for platforms other than Linux.
You do not need system portal integration.
strengths: Provides a native Dart client implementation of xdg-desktop-portal.
Includes support for numerous portal features like notifications, file choosers, and settings.
weaknesses: Not documented details beyond basic usage and changelogs.
data.setup_notes: Requires Linux desktop environment with xdg-desktop-portal support.
